beats: The kitchen TV's weekly calendar looked nearly empty — even though most of the family's real schedule lived in Google Calendar.
A kiosk that never logs into anything could never see events hidden behind a login.
Now it pulls those events in and merges them with the household calendar and the sports app.
Every event is color-coded, so one glance shows whether it's sports, a handwritten note, or the calendar itself.
Three separate sources, one real week, nothing invisible anymore.
